summary: BT Brands filed an 8-K announcing termination of its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Aero Velocity Inc. The merger, under which Aero would become a wholly owned subsidiary via a merger sub, was terminated on May 1, 2026 because the registration statement was not declared effective and the closing did not occur by the extended deadline of April 30, 2026. Company exercised termination right under Section 7.1(b); no termination fee is payable, and each party bears its own expenses. Watch for any litigation or alternative transaction.
